TASK: CPC technology areas in Germany with the highest exponential moving average (alpha = 0.1)
of patent filings per year, for patents granted in the second half of 2019 (July 1 - Dec 31, 2019),
reported at CPC hierarchy level 4 (class level, e.g. H01).

METHOD:
- Selected German patents (publication numbers starting with "DE-") from publicationinfo whose
  natural-language grant_date falls in July-December 2019: 34 patents.
- Parsed each patent's filing year from filing_date; filing years span 2007-2018.
- Extracted each patent's CPC codes and mapped them to level-4 groups (first 3 characters,
  matching cpc_definition rows with level = 4), deduplicated per patent.
- Counted filings per CPC level-4 group per year, reindexed over the full 2007-2018 range
  (missing years = 0), and computed the EMA with smoothing factor 0.1
  (pandas ewm(alpha=0.1, adjust=False), i.e. EMA_t = 0.1*count_t + 0.9*EMA_{t-1}).
- For each group, took its highest EMA value and the year in which that peak occurs ("best year"),
  then ranked all groups by that peak EMA.

RESULTS - Top 10 CPC level-4 groups by highest EMA of yearly filings:

Rank | CPC group | Full title                                                              | Best year | Peak EMA
-----|-----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|---------
  1  | B41       | PRINTING; LINING MACHINES; TYPEWRITERS; STAMPS                          | 2007      | 1.0000
  2  | B29       | WORKING OF PLASTICS; WORKING OF SUBSTANCES IN A PLASTIC STATE IN GENERAL| 2007      | 1.0000
  3  | G01       | MEASURING; TESTING                                                      | 2018      | 0.4788
  4  | Y02       | TECHNOLOGIES OR APPLICATIONS FOR MITIGATION OR ADAPTATION AGAINST CLIMATE CHANGE | 2018 | 0.4219
  5  | F02       | COMBUSTION ENGINES; HOT-GAS OR COMBUSTION-PRODUCT ENGINE PLANTS         | 2018      | 0.4055
  6  | B60       | VEHICLES IN GENERAL                                                     | 2018      | 0.3444
  7  | H01       | ELECTRIC ELEMENTS                                                       | 2013      | 0.3300
  8  | A61       | MEDICAL OR VETERINARY SCIENCE; HYGIENE                                  | 2016      | 0.3000
  9  | F16       | ENGINEERING ELEMENTS AND UNITS; GENERAL MEASURES FOR PRODUCING AND MAINTAINING EFFECTIVE FUNCTIONING OF MACHINES OR INSTALLATIONS; THERMAL INSULATION IN GENERAL | 2018 | 0.2522
 10  | H04       | ELECTRIC COMMUNICATION TECHNIQUE                                        | 2015      | 0.2000

The single highest-EMA CPC technology areas are B41 (PRINTING; LINING MACHINES; TYPEWRITERS;
STAMPS) and B29 (WORKING OF PLASTICS...), both peaking in 2007 with EMA = 1.0; among groups with
sustained/recent filing activity, G01 (MEASURING; TESTING) leads with its best year 2018
(EMA = 0.4788).

Note: only 34 German (DE) patents in the database were granted in H2 2019, so the cohort is small
and early-year single filings dominate the EMA due to standard EMA initialization at the first
observation.
